newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes flat at 1,595-1,600 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes flat at 1,595-1,600 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed between 1,595-1,600 per dollar, virtually flat from the morning's 1,594-1,599, after an active interbank trade, dealers said.
"The lev traded range bound around opening levels with most deals at 1,598-1,599 as dollar supply was large and was absorbed mainly by the central bank," one dealer said.
Central bank officials were not available for comment.
Foreign currency supply from banks and clients was high because they needed levs to meet salary and tax payments due at end-month and end-quarter, traders said.
